title: senecio leucophyllus subsp. incanus
intro: Senecio leucophyllus subsp. incanus, commonly known as the Incane Daisy or White Leaf Woolly Groundsel, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its multiple health benefits, including treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its use as a diuretic and anti-inflammatory agent. The plant is believed to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Senecio leucophyllus subsp. incanus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
